# 🚨 Incident Report

- Incident ID:
- Severity:
- Status:
- Start and end time (include timezone):
- Incident lead:
- Affected release / commit:

## 🧭 Summary
Describe what happened, what was affected, and how users experienced it.

## 🔎 Detection
How was the incident detected? Include alerts, reports, or observations.

## ⏱️ Timeline

| Time | Event | Action / owner |
|---|---|---|
| | | |

## 🎯 Impact
List affected pages, visitors, services, and duration. Separate confirmed facts from estimates.

## 🧩 Root cause
Explain the confirmed technical or process cause. Mark unresolved hypotheses clearly.

## 🛠️ Mitigation and recovery
Record actions taken and evidence that service was restored.

## 📣 Communication
Record relevant stakeholder or user updates without exposing private information.

## 📋 Follow-up actions

| Action | Owner | Priority | Due date | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| | | | | |

## 📚 Lessons learned
Identify process and system improvements. Focus on prevention rather than blame.
